method: Export native fields from both runs at every listed completed frame. Conservatively volume-restrict active 128-base cells onto active 64-base cells, requiring complete active volume coverage and exact matched times. Divide velocity and force L2 differences by the corresponding restricted finer-field L2 norm.

spatial_screen.eligible_sequence: At least three consecutive listed checkpoints pass both limits; disclose all listed failures and do not interpolate across failures.

remaining_qualification: Require the 64-base run to complete and pass its native archive audit, then obtain a fixed-force halved-timestep comparison on a comparable refined mesh with a velocity gap below one-quarter of the spatial gap. Audit peak, support, vorticity, energy, and discrete residual behavior across the candidate sequence.
scope: A practical finite-resolution visualization screen. The manufactured force and target are grid-dependent, so passing this screen would not establish convergence for one fixed continuum forcing or prove singularity formation.
